notes.subject: תרנין
notes.rationale: רנן i tok 'singaut long amamas'; sampela tanim tok i putim 'amamas' tasol, sampela 'sing' — mi holim tupela.

notes.subject: scary
notes.rationale: ירא i gat tupela mining: scary na respek — 'stand in awe' (jps); Tok Pisin 'scary' i holim namba wan mining tasol.

translation: Ol manmeri i stap long ol kona bilong graun i save scary long ol mak bilong yu; ol ples we moning na apinun i save kamap long en, yu mekim ol i singaut long amamas.
